items.ai_summary: A proof-of-concept exploit chain has been released for CVE-2026-15718, targeting a missing-sync flaw in SpiderMonkey's wasm baseline compiler array.fill implementation. This vulnerability leads to an invalid pointer state, enabling addrOf/fakeobj primitives and arbitrary read/write capabilities culminating in remote code execution.
